subject: Function-identifier
notes: kb/Work/PB757.md landed w46i2. FUNCTION f(... OMITTED ...) against a formal without the OPTIONAL phrase is COBOL2238 (negative); against an OPTIONAL formal it binds to the omitted CALL-ABI argument (golden PB757F). Before PB757 every OMITTED user-function argument was a staged COBOL1506.
